==Summary==

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Egwene is working in the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]]'s Study grateful she finally has a real desk and chair. Everything [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]] had in the room has been removed, so the walls are bare. [[Silviana]] is showing herself to be an effective [[Keeper of the Chronicles|Keeper]] and choosing her has brought at least a truce with the [[Red Ajah]]. [[Romanda]] and [[Lelaine]] are unhappy that Egwene plans to train the captured ''[[damane]]'' to be [[Aes Sedai]]. Another sixty [[Black Ajah]] sisters managed to escape, including [[Alviarin Freidhen|Alviarin]], but a few of the weakest were captured since they weren't able to use [[Traveling]]. The [[Seanchan]] captured two dozen [[Aes Sedai]] and almost as many [[Accepted]] or [[novices]]. [[Mesaana]] was not found and may still be in the Tower, somehow getting around using the [[Oath Rod]].

Silviana requests Egwene come to the Hall of the Sitters where they look out at [[Dragonmount]] through the hole in the wall made during the Seanchan attack. The clouds have broken in a circular ring centered on Dragonmount. Egwene asks Silviana to mark the date, expecting to someday know what the sunlight means.

{{Quote |quote=At the end of time, when the many become one, the last storm shall gather its angry winds to destroy a land already dying. And at its center, the blind man shall stand upon his own grave. There he shall see again, and weep for what has been wrought. |description=- from the ''[[Prophecies of the Dragon]]'', [[Essanik Cycle]]. Malhavish's Official Translation, Imperial Record House of [[Seandar]], Fourth Circle of Elevation.}}
